checks.name: Coupled curvature block satisfies independently recomputed linear residual

Continuous material has no central duplicate seam and bends cross centre

Thickness and bending inputs are separate from declared areal mass
Tangent contact conserves free mass-weighted centre without external support
Curvature stiffness changes free cantilever response under matched gravity
Thin, standard and thick folding remain continuous with small settled opening
Exact web dimensions, mass convention and friction keep all three folds within the same gates
The finite-width moving clamp holds only the outer two columns and fully releases both
Edge release and reopening retain physical time, mass and topology
Transport array dimensions match the connected rendering grid
Invalid inputs are rejected, not silently converted to motion
Old material solver and cotton source remain unchanged
